Where Does the Power to Create Change Begin? | Wendi Williams, Ph.D. | TEDxAtlanta
recentItems.description:
What does a circle of schoolgirls in Brooklyn have in common with a movement that helped bring down the Berlin Wall? 

Psychologist and leadership scholar Wendi Williams connects two seemingly unrelated stories to explore where the power to create change begins, what it takes to keep going when there's no guarantee that our efforts will make a difference. In her work, Wendi Williams reimagines leadership by focusing on how power  is created. 

A psychologist, educator and leadership scholar, Wendi has spent her career examining how identity, power and belonging shape the way people lead and thrive. Her work challenges traditional models of leadership centered on authority and individual achievement, focusing instead on what becomes possible when people create opportunity for one another.

Wendi is president of the American Psychological Association and founder of The Well, a leadership development and consulting practice. Previously, she served as provost and senior vice president at Fielding Graduate University and dean of the School of Education at Mills College. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: The trap of trying to earn your place | Dyllón Burnside | TEDxAtlanta
recentItems.description:
A Broadway debut. A breakthrough TV role. An Emmy-winning documentary. What happens when every milestone still leaves you waiting for someone to say you belong? Actor Dyllón Burnside traces a question that reaches far beyond the stage. Dyllón Burnside has built a career telling stories that challenge who gets to belong, and who gets to decide.

An Emmy Award-winning filmmaker, actor, singer and writer, Dyllón is best known for playing Ricky Evangelista on the FX series “Pose.” Across stage and screen, his work has explored identity, belonging and the power of being seen.

Beyond performing, Dyllón is the founder of Soul Flower Farm, a Georgia-based creative retreat where artists reconnect with themselves, one another and the land. His advocacy also helped advance Georgia House Resolution 1007, recognizing the arts as a resource for mental health and well-being. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Starting Without a Roadmap: How Unexpected Turns Lead to True Aim | Mr. Harshal Dilwali | TEDxSRHU
recentItems.description: Feeling pressured by peers who seem to have their entire career mapped out while you are still figuring things out? In this inspiring talk, Mr. Harshal Dilwali shares how an unexpected entry into the hospitality industry taught him that not having a definitive five-year plan is completely okay. From tackling humble, ground-level tasks to learning vital lessons from a wild snake dropping into a jungle property, Mr. Dilwali illustrates why early jobs do not need to be glamorous to be valuable. He reframes rejection not as permanent failure, but as an indicator that you are simply "not ready yet". Ultimately, he urges students to stop waiting for the right opportunity, start small, and let action and preparation guide them toward their true direction. Founder and CEO of Clarissa Group, an entrepreneur and advocate driving leadership, innovation and meaningful impact across diverse spheres. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Future of Leadership in a Collective World | Olajumoke Caxton- Martins | TEDxLead City University
recentItems.description:
Olajumoke Caxton Martins explores how leadership is shifting from individual authority to shared purpose. In a world where the hardest problems cannot be solved by one person, she argues that the leaders who will matter most are those who build with others, listen well, and make room for many voices. This talk challenges the audience to move beyond “me” and embrace the strength of “we.” Olajumoke is a multifaceted leader. She is lawyer, business consultant, and mentor. She helps people maximize their potential.

With certifications in law, philanthropy, and leadership, she’s a Fellow of the Institute of Management Consultants and mentor with the Nigerian Bar Association Women Forum.

Through Life Mastery Academy and Dream Catchers, she empowers women and individuals to achieve financial intelligence and personal growth.

As Group MD of Abib Olamitoye Group, she leads a consortium of hospitals and hotels, while inspiring leaders and voices through her work as author, speaker, and coach. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Why Collaboration is Africa's Hidden Currency. | Paul Olubori | TEDxLead City University
recentItems.description:
Paul Olubori is a real estate entrepreneur who has built businesses that generate billions of naira in revenue, and he is now building more. In this talk, he argues that Africa’s young builders will not win alone. Drawing on his own journey in real estate, he shows how partnerships, shared vision, and trust turn small ideas into large ventures. He challenges young people to stop competing in isolation and start building together, because collaboration is the most undervalued asset on the continent. Olubori Paul is a visionary businessman, finance coach, and mentor committed to empowering youths toward financial freedom and wealth creation.

As the founder of GO Holding, comprising Golearn, GoDigits, GoRealty, and GoFarms, he has hosted 7 finance conferences with over 15,000 attendees, trained 5,000+ forex traders, and helped over 1,000 youths build wealth through real estate and agriculture.

Through his platform “Entrepreneurship with Olubori Paul,” he continues to inspire and equip the next generation of leaders. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Who Am I? | Khalifa Albarra Damanik | TEDxCRIBS Youth
recentItems.description:
Have you ever looked at your friends and thought, “I wish I were more like them” Maybe they are kinder, smarter, or better at schoolwork. Yes, I thought about that too, I saw my friend and asked to myself “Why are they better than me?”, “Why are they smarter than me?” or “Why are they more talented than me?”. So i started copying them in many things like their habits, handwriting, even speaking style. I copied many things from them, at first I thought it was common for a 13 years old teenager like me. But then I realized that I started to feel like something was missing. I was trying so hard to become someone else that I hadn't really stopped to ask who I was.
 I am an eighth-grader student from Cahaya Rancamaya Islamic Boarding School ~ Junior high
who was born on December 3, 2012, in Depok, and still lives in Pancoran mas district, Depok My
hobby is reading books, drawing and playing video games. The reason why i join TEDx is to

program i can gain more confidence and learn valuable experiences that will help me to grow in the
future. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: S'habiter pleinement  | Mounia Nassangar | TEDxLeboncoin
recentItems.description:
Adolescente cherchant à disparaître, Mounia découvre avec le waacking une manière de prendre toute sa place et de devenir le personnage principal de sa propre histoire. En construisant un alter ego puissant, elle apprend progressivement à habiter son corps, avant de comprendre que la force passe aussi par l’écoute et l’acceptation de sa vulnérabilité. Aujourd’hui, elle transmet cette liberté aux autres : prendre pleinement sa place, sans empêcher quiconque de prendre la sienne.
Crédit musical : Amb3r D3sp0t  Figure importante du waacking en France et à l’international, Mounia Nassangar est chorégraphe, danseuse, modèle, DJ, productrice événementielle. Dansant depuis l’âge de 10 ans, elle est passée par le popping, le locking, le new style, la house dance, le dancehall et le street jazz avant de se spécialiser dans le waacking. 
Révélée au grand public grâce au Fashion Freak Show de Jean-Paul Gaultier aux Folies Bergère et au film Climax de Gaspar Noé, primé à la Quinzaine des réalisateurs lors du Festival de Cannes en 2018, elle chorégraphie Aya Nakamura dans le clip "SMS" où elle figure et opère en tant que movement director pour Kelela. On peut la voir danser dans le clip de Travis Scott, "MODERN JAM" ou MCBH d’asare dont elle signe la chorégraphie également. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: The Dots That Always Overlapped | Avanti Natarajan | TEDxThe Pupil International School Youth
recentItems.description:
Avanti Natarajan, in her insightful talk, explores how subjects like science, mathematics, architecture, and engineering connect to solve real-world challenges. She inspires us to think beyond boundaries, embrace collaboration, and discover how the dots always overlap. 
 Avanti Natarajan is an architect, design strategist, and edupreneur working across education, spatial design, and enterprise systems. Trained at Anna University and Pratt Institute, New York, she serves as Director of Student Affairs at Paavai Educational Institutions, where she leads experiential and cross-disciplinary learning initiatives. Avanti is the co-founder of strategic design consultancy Tab Infinity and cultural initiative Lil Trails, and serves as Vice Chairperson of the CII Indian Women Network, Tamil Nadu. Her work focuses on dismantling academic silos to help students and organizations connect disparate ideas into holistic solutions. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Kreni prema vrhu kojeg samo ti vidiš | Matej Perkov | TEDxKoprivnica Library
recentItems.description: Putem fotografija i priča trudim se dočarati specifičnost i magiju putovanja u kontekstu planinarenja i ekspedicionizma. Ali prije svega, ukazujem na važnost ljepote samog puta prema cilju koji obuhvaća trening, posvećenost, motivaciju, okruženje kvalitetnim ljudima i kreiranje svakodnevice koja nas usrećuje. Dostizanje cilja nije cilj, već je sam PUT taj koji je važan. Put nas motivira da uživamo u svakodnevici, da ne padnemo u zamku praznine nakon što smo neki cilj ostvarili te da osvijestimo da živimo u specifično vrijeme kada imamo puno veće mogućnosti negoli su to imale prijašnje generacije.  Koprivničanac koji u svojim četrdesetima uspješno traži novu mladost i snagu po planinama diljem svijeta. Zakoračivši u svijet planinarstva na domaćoj Bilogori u djetinjstvu, njegove prazne stranice dnevnike ispisane su zanimljivim planinarskim pričama iz cijele Hrvatske, s Balkana, Alpi, marokanskog Atlasa, Kavkaza, iranskog Damavanda, Himalaja i Pamira.  Široj javnosti poznat kao visokogorski planinar i maratonac, po struci je turistički ekonomist i svoja iskustva već godinama prenosi studentima kao gradivo na predavanjima, a svoje putopisne nastupe održava diljem Hrvatske. Snimio je deset dokumentarnih filmova i autor je četiri knjige: “Planinarenje je način izražavanja”, “Želim dotaknuti nebo”, “Planina mi je najdraža škola” i “Pišem grafite na duši planine”. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Od uvažavanja prava i potreba djece do hiperprotektivnosti | Neda Vac Burić | TEDxKoprivnica Library
recentItems.description: Odrastala sam u vremenu kada su posramljivanje i krutost u odgoju bili sastavni dio pristupa djeci. Kao mlada psihologinja gutala sam literaturu Jespera Juula. U svim segmentima rada promoviram ravnopravno dostojanstvo i druge vrijednosti o kojima Juul govori. Važno je kako se dijete osjeća. Važno je pomoći djetetu i biti mu podrška. Ali kada, kako i koliko? Danas sve češće to podrazumijeva da i roditelji i dijete misle da je važna samo perspektiva  djeteta. Mi odrasli iz najbolje namjere  djecu štitimo od neugodnosti i radimo umjesto njih umjesto da budemo podrška dok djeca pokušavaju i griješe – jer tako savladavaju važne životne vještine. Zato kao psihologinja i stručnjakinja u radu s djecom i njima važnim odraslima smatram nužnim sustavno raditi na osvještavanju ove teme i pomagati u osnaživanju djece i mladih danas -  ali bez medvjeđih usluga! Neda Vac Burić diplomirana je psihologinja, od 1999. godine zaposlena u dječjem vrtiću. Veliki utjecaj na njen profesionalni i osobni život imala je četverogodišnja edukacija gestalt psihoterapijskog pristupa, kao i suradnja s Jesperom Juulom, a od 2008. provodi seminare za roditelje za Familylab Hrvatska koji je osnovao Jesper Juul. Od 2014. provodi program podrške za roditelje Rastimo zajedno. Njena posebna profesionalna ljubav pripada obiteljima u tugovanju i kroz različite segmente rada predškolskog psihologa radi već 20 godina na promicanju važnosti ove teme. Posvećenost ovom području dovela je do priključivanja u provedbu aktivnosti programa PUT – psihosocijalne podrške tugujućima od samog početka programa PUT i suradnje s udrugom Luč. Pored toga, suradnica je Psihološkog centra TESA i udruge CeliVita – život s celijakijom. Dobitnica je Društvenog priznanja Marulić: Fiat Psychologia za osobito vrijedan doprinos razvitku i promicanju hrvatske primijenjene psihologije. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Reci: vulva. Što gubimo kada prešutimo dio sebe | Martina Tuta | TEDxKoprivnica Library
recentItems.description: Središnja ideja je jednostavna: ono što ne smijemo imenovati, ne možemo ni njegovati. Imenovanjem tijela i stvaranjem prostora u kojem žene mogu govoriti i biti saslušane otvaramo vrata znanju, podršci i pomoći, i vraćamo si dio sebe koji smo prešutjele. Znam, jer pomažući drugim ženama da progovore, prvi put zacjeljujem i ono što sam sama godinama prešućivala. Martina Tuta diplomirana je novinarka, magistra marketinga i certificirana fitoterapeutkinja, edukantica tjelesne integrativne psihoterapije i osnivačica Biljkoljupke te autorica, voditeljica i producentica podcasta „Vulva je WOW!“, prvog hrvatskog podcasta posvećenog ženskom intimnom zdravlju u kojem s ginekologinjama, specijalisticama humane reprodukcije i stvarnim ženama otvara teme o kojima se kod nas i dalje šapće: od intimne njege i bolnih odnosa do neplodnosti, gubitka trudnoće i različitih puteva prema majčinstvu This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community.
